items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee describes Buck and Bubbles' performance and influence on Jimmy Lunceford's 'Stump the Band' but does not mention any personal interaction, meeting, or collaboration with Buck and Bubbles themselves.

ctx.x: Were there things that you created on your own?

Well, we had our dance, like 'Sweet Sue', and 'Broadway Melody', and 'Bugle Call Rag', you know, like those things. One time Daddy had us to doing like 'Broadway Melody', and then Buck and Bubbles' theme song, which was, 'Rhythm For Sale'. And eventually, see, they taught us how to sing the song, see, and M.C. Bubbles had sung it, and Buck and Bubbles were both of them singing it first. After they got on the stage they would sing.
